profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software engineer from Kentucky.  I first became interested in technology after exposure to immersive, virtual worlds as a teenager, which led me toward a degree program in Architecture, and later Computer Science.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Led enterprise development team managing front-of-house services and webapps. Projects included waitlisting, reservations, guest search, sms and webhook scheduling, internal data pipelines via SNS/SQS pubsub, internal data retention workers, and two-way data sync with on-site applications.

Principally responsible for the long-term maintenance, monitoring, and CI/CD of an RPC-based monolithic service that processed millions of requests per hour.

Engaged in architecture planning, coding, code review, testing, deployment, and production incident response. Worked with business analysts to break user stories into technical subtasks that could be delegated to junior engineers. Mentored junior engineers across development teams.

Was frequently consulted by other teams, culminating in administration of our internal "Stack Overflow for Teams" site; personally seeded over 100 questions and answers addressing various internal products and drove initiatives to improve knowledge-sharing culture internally.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Inherited the development, maintenance, and deployment of a legacy monolith webservice that drove front-of-house enterprise functionality. Balanced implementation of numerous performance improvements to this service while also maintaining a schedule of new features. Introduced a cache layer to ease high-volume reads of critical business resources. Introduced alternate, temporary data storage of this same resource for non-critical entries.

Implemented suites of microservices for various business cases.  Projects included injestion of data from on-site applications for fan-out to various services, data streaming, and scheduling/preparation of "reminder" SMS.

Developed deployment strategy for legacy .NET Framework services via AWS CodeDeploy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented and maintained .NET 4.5 APIs and workers that serviced various mobile and web applications. Handled backend CRUD and schema design. Responsible for production deployment of the above; implemented powershell automations to bootstrap Windows Server with these services installed and imaged as Amazon AMIs.

Lead on several microservices, including a generic report processor that handled report execution requests asynchronously, interfacing with reporting engines in a series of background workers that evaluated execution status, downloaded completed reports from the reporting engine, and uploaded reports to Amazon S3 upon completion.

Implemented CI/CD solutions for web services.  

Implemented solutions to manage and automate production notifications with AWS SNS, AWS Lambda, and AWS CloudWatch/CloudWatch Logs.

positions.title: Computer Lab Consultant
positions.description: On-site consultant in University of Kentucky student computer labs.  Assisted lab patrons with UK web account issues, Mac OS X and Windows 7 software issues, and printing issues.  Reported computer and printer hardware issues to the appropriate parties, when necessary.

positions.title: Virtual World Content Developer
positions.description:
Hobbyist development of the SW City 3D virtual environment with a team of a dozen individuals, primarily using Active Worlds -- an early virtual worlds development platform that was first created as "AlphaWorld" in 1995.

Content developer for the SW City Interactive MMORPG -- a browser-based web game that interfaced with the Active Worlds environment.  Developed experimental game-types with focus on integrating player-generated content into the SW City environment, downloadable object groups that feature SW City Interactive content that could be used by players elsewhere in the Active Worlds software, over 30 in-game stories and activities using our web-based admin tool.

Active development of this project has ceased, but team maintains contact and we continue to maintenance the game from time-to-time.

honors.title: Finalist in AWS Re:Invent Alexa Skill Contest
honors.description:
Collaborated with a team to build a prototype Alexa skill for DineTime.

* Contest page: https://www.hackster.io/contests/alexa-reinvent
* Project page: https://www.hackster.io/dinetime/dinetime-alexa-skill-e63a9d?ref=challenge&ref_id=82&offset=2

projects.title: Pivott
projects.description: Completed for Senior Design (CS 499) at the University of Kentucky, "Pivott" is a prototype web application that transforms static health data into dynamic charts and graphs.  The user's health information is amalgamated from various web services via the Singly API, and can be viewed from a single widget on the user's profile page, which is managed by the Django web framework.  Extensive documentation and project management functionality can be found at the link above.
